title: Late missing-item report without evidence of an emergency
facts_text: My order was delivered 60 hours ago, and the main dish was missing. I was on a call and could not report it sooner. The order records support that the main dish was not delivered. I do not have a photo because the dish never arrived.
request: Can you refund the missing main dish and its tax?

strict.reason: The report was made after the 48-hour deadline, and the strict variant permits no deadline extension.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: Although the report is within 72 hours and order records support the claim, no documented unforeseen emergency prevented an earlier report.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The policy leaves exceptional circumstances undefined, so the agent may review the individual facts; approval is not guaranteed.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with uber_eats_001_missing_item_emergency: the order and timing match, but this case lacks the documented emergency required by the explicit exception. Confirm the ambiguous reference permits discretion without implying automatic approval.
